name: margdarshak
description: Margdarshak: a reference citizen front end plus an open adapter specification for India's driving-licence journey. Independent prototype, not affiliated with MoRTH/NIC/State Transport Departments.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,console,api,verifier -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @margdarshak/web dev" "pnpm --filter @margdarshak/console dev" "pnpm api:dev" "pnpm --filter @margdarshak/score-verifier dev"
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:ts && pnpm lint:next && pnpm lint:py && pnpm lint:facts
scripts.lint:py: cd services/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run lint-imports
scripts.lint:facts: tsx scripts/lint_wording.ts && uv run --project services/api python scripts/lint_facts.py
scripts.format: biome format --write . && cd services/api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.typecheck:py: cd services/api && uv run mypy src tests && cd ../workflows && uv run mypy src
scripts.test:py: cd services/api && uv run pytest -n auto --cov=margdarshak --cov-report=term-missing
scripts.test:golden: cd services/api && uv run pytest tests/golden -q
scripts.test:contract: cd services/api && uv run pytest tests/contract -q -m "not real"
scripts.test:contract:real: cd services/api && uv run pytest tests/contract -q -m real
scripts.ai:eval: cd services/api && uv run adk eval src/margdarshak/adapters/outbound/ai/agents ../../ai/evals
scripts.api:dev: cd services/api && uv run uvicorn margdarshak.main:create_app --factory --reload --port 8000
scripts.workflows:dev: cd services/workflows && render workflows dev -- uv run python -m margdarshak_workflows
scripts.py:sync: cd services/api && uv sync --all-extras --dev && cd ../workflows && uv sync --dev
scripts.db:migrate: cd services/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd services/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate
scripts.db:seed: cd services/api && uv run python -m margdarshak.scripts.seed
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.dev.yml down -v && pnpm infra:up
scripts.n8n:import: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.dev.yml exec n8n n8n import:workflow --separate --input=/n8n/workflows
scripts.release: echo Releases are cut by the release-please GitHub Action on main; see docs/03-engineering/GIT_WORKFLOW.md section 6.2
